item.title: SwiftData Enum Predicates: Store a Queryable Raw Value
item.description: SwiftData can persist Codable enums, but current #Predicate expressions cannot compare enum cases. Store a raw value when you need filtering or sorting.

item.title: CloudKit Rejects @Attribute(.unique) — Model Around It
item.description: SwiftData's unique constraint is incompatible with CloudKit sync. Why there's no workaround, and how to enforce uniqueness without it.

item.title: SwiftData's String SortDescriptor Isn't Sorting How You Think
item.description: A SortDescriptor on a String key path defaults to .localizedStandard, which is numeric-aware and locale-dependent — so it disagrees with Swift's < and changes per user.

item.title: What Locales We Translate To, and Why
item.description: Four languages are non-negotiable, another fifteen are nearly free, and English-only leaves most of the App Store unreachable. The reasoning behind the list.

item.title: We Translate Every String As We Write It
item.description: Why retrofitting localisation into an iOS app always leaks, and the SwiftUI patterns that silently break translation without warning you.

item.title: Every SwiftData Property Needs a Default Value
item.description: If you use SwiftData with CloudKit and a property has no default, the store fails silently and every fetch returns empty. Here's why, and the fix.
